card.name: "With" after patients in exclusions
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after "patients" (or "men") in contraindication or avoid-use statements, introducing a condition such as long QT or hypotension. Also weakly on "known" or "serious" before hypersensitivity.

modes.label: With after patients
modes.description: The word "with" introduces a listed condition in a do-not-use or avoid-use statement.
modes.example: Avoid use in patients<< with>> congenital long QT syndrome.

modes.label: Qualifier before hypersensitivity
modes.description: "known" or "serious" sits before hypersensitivity reaction in a contraindication list.
